name: adsterra-advertiser
description: Work with your Adsterra advertiser account from your AI agent: statistics, campaigns, budgets, placements, custom bids and campaign activity.

api_key.title: Adsterra MCP token
api_key.description: Token with type MCP from Settings → API in your Adsterra advertiser account.

server_url.title: Connector URL
server_url.description: Do not change it: the plugin sends your token to this address. Adsterra never asks advertisers to change it.
